caption: A hairdryer is aimed at a wet patch on a bathroom mirror, and the patch shrinks from its edges.

sa.check: A wet patch lies on a bathroom mirror.
A hairdryer is aimed at the patch.
The dry area spreads from where the warm air hits.
The drying comes first at the patch's edges.

pc.expect: The patch only shrinks while the dryer plays on it and dried glass stays dry.
pc.fail: The patch grows while the dryer plays on it; or a dried part of the glass goes wet again with nothing wetting it; or the patch shrinks and grows in turn; or the patch shrinks before the dryer is aimed at it.

pc.expect: The water goes by drying from the patch's edge inward and does not appear elsewhere on the glass.
pc.fail: A new wet patch appears on dry glass; or the patch jumps to a new place on the mirror; or the patch vanishes at a stroke while still large; or the patch shrinks while a matching patch grows beside it.

pc.expect: The drying starts where the warm air hits and spreads from there, while glass the dryer does not reach stays wet.
pc.fail: The patch dries from its far side while the dryer plays on its near side; or the whole mirror dries at once while the dryer plays on one spot; or the dryer plays on the patch and it stays as wet as before to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: Any water the air pushes runs downward on the glass and gathers at the mirror's lower edge.
pc.fail: A run travels up the mirror; or a drop leaves the glass and rises; or water gathers along the mirror's top edge and stays; or the pushed water hangs in the air beside the glass.

pc.expect: One mirror in its frame; the mirror keeps its shape and the dryer stays outside the glass.
pc.fail: The mirror changes shape; or the dryer passes into the glass; or a second mirror appears; or the frame vanishes.

pc.expect: The frame, the bathroom fittings and the room behind stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes colour; or the fittings move; or the room behind changes between frames.
